name: pyo3-boundary
description: Go to definition across the PyO3 boundary: from Python into the Rust that implements it, and from the Python names Rust calls by string into the Python that defines them.

pyo3Boundary.pythonRoots.description: Extra directories Python module names resolve from, relative to the workspace folder. Workspace folders and maturin's `python-source` are always searched.

pyo3Boundary.exclude.description: Glob of Rust and pyproject files left out of the index.

pyo3Boundary.highlightTestCode.description: Tint the background of Rust code that only compiles under `cfg(test)`. The color is the `pyo3Boundary.testCodeBackground` theme color.

colors.description: Background of Rust code that only compiles under cfg(test).
